title: Hardship Relief Provision — Equipment & Vehicle Loans Deferral Fee After a Casualty
content:
**Provision.** An Equipment & Vehicle Loans deferral fee carries casualty relief: it is multiplied by 0.5 when a unit of the loan was released on a total loss less than 12 whole months before the grant and the loan carries no late charge dated less than 12 whole months before; by 0.75 when a unit was released on a total loss in those 12 months and the loan carries such a late charge; and by 1.0 when no unit was released on a total loss in those 12 months. The multiplication applies to the deferral fee as figured, before any amount is added to or taken off the fee; only the final total is rounded to cents, and it is never less than zero.

## Records it rests on

- the loan's collateral record: releases with the release reason total loss, by date;
- the loan's transaction history: late-charge fee entries, by date.

## Relief by combination

| Total-loss release on the loan within 12 whole months before the grant | Late charge on the loan within 12 whole months | Multiplier on the fee as figured |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | 0.5 |
| yes | yes | 0.75 |
| no | either | 1.0 (the fee as figured) |

## Hypothetical figures

- Fee as figured 250.00, a pivot destroyed and released on a total loss four months before the grant, no late charge in the year: 125.00.
- Same, with one late charge eight months before the grant: 187.50.
- A release on sale, not on a total loss, within the 12 months: the fee stays as figured.
